title: A universal deep learning framework for empowering nanopore identification by reinforcing temporal signals
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 18 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74507-w

Nanopore sensing struggles to resolve structurally similar molecules from noisy temporal signals. Here, authors present SEDA-Former, which integrates multi-scale temporal enhancement and progressive adaptive attention training, to achieve robust and accurate classification across diverse molecular datasets.

title: Flexible infrared camouflage eutectic gallium-indium for thermoelectric energy harvesting
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 18 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74580-1

Eutectic gallium indium is proposed to address the challenge of integrating infrared camouflage with self-powered thermoelectric sensing, enabling simultaneous concealment of thermal signatures and real-time physiological monitoring without complex fabrication.

title: Strong yet highly conductive liquid metal composite film constructed via friction induced in-situ synthesis
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 18 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74665-x

Contact resistance limits device performance. Here, the authors fabricate a strong yet highly conductive liquid-metal-bridged nanogranular composite via friction induced in-situ synthesis, achieving low contact resistivity and high current density.

title: Atomically precise Au<sub>8</sub>Pd<sub>1</sub>(DPPF)<sub>4</sub><sup>2+</sup> catalyst orchestrates the synthesis and utilization of hydrogen peroxide
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 18 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74604-w

Atomically precise metal clusters that combine structural clarity, functional modularity, and spatial programmability are becoming increasingly relevant. Here, the authors report the synthesis and applications of the cluster-based Au8Pd1(DPPF)42+/Al2O3 catalyst for hydrogen peroxide generation.

title: L1CAM signaling through planar cell polarity drives SOX2 expression and lung adenocarcinoma metastasis
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 18 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74539-2

How metastatic progenitor cells emerge and persist remains to be understood. Here the authors show that in lung adenocarcinoma progenitors, the cell adhesion molecule L1CAM drives SOX2 expression via the planar cell polarity complex to sustain regenerative and metastatic capacity.

title: Structural dissection of the catalytic domain of the serine threonine kinase StkP of Streptococcus pneumoniae
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 18 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74470-6

PASTA-kinases govern the bacterial cell cycle. Here, authors solve the structure of the catalytic domain of the protein kinase StkP from Streptococcus pneumoniae and provide a mechanistic framework for its activation and regulation.

title: Process-separated cascade catalysis for highly efficient alkane-to-aromatic conversion
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 18 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74607-7

Light alkanes offer a route to key aromatics, but controlling competing catalytic steps remains difficult. This study separates and matches reaction stages to boost benzene, toluene and xylene production.

title: Sulfonyl-PYBOX/ErCl<sub>3</sub> complex enable highly enantioselective synthesis of α,α-dialkyl and α-alkyl-α-aryl hydrazinonitriles
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 18 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74600-0

Authors present an ErCl₃-catalyzed cyanation of both aliphatic and aryl ketone hydrazones for the facile access of C(alpha)-tetrasubstituted alpha-hydrazino nitriles in up to 96% ee, by using a sterically confined pyridinebisoxazoline (PYBOX) ligand featuring a sulfonyl group at the pyridine C4 position.
